import urllib.request
import json

url = "https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/P0DTE4.json"
req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent': 'Python/3'})
with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as resp:
    p0dte4 = json.loads(resp.read().decode())

print("P0DTE4 sequence:", p0dte4.get('sequence'))
print("P0DTE4 comments/features:", [c.get('commentType') for c in p0dte4.get('comments', [])])
for c in p0dte4.get('comments', []):
    print(c)
